entities.summary: Anthony Green is an American singer from Doylestown, Pennsylvania. He is currently the lead singer of the Sound of Animals Fighting, and L.S. Dunes, while also maintaining a solo career. He was previously in the bands Saosin, Audience of One, Circa Survive, Jeer at Rome, High and Driving, and Zolof the Rock & Roll Destroyer.
